items.source: Note: this method will only be invoked after HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler.supportsReturnType(org.springframework.core.MethodParameter) is called and it returns true.
items.translation: 注意： 此方法仅在调用HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler.supportsReturnType(org.springframework.core.MethodParameter)并返回true后才会被调用。

items.source: Implementations should consider extending the convenient base class AbstractAsyncReturnValueHandler.
items.translation: 实现应考虑扩展方便的基类 AbstractAsyncReturnValueHandler。

items.source:
Return value handling will then continue when
the CompletableFuture is completed with either success or error.
items.translation: 返回值的处理将在 CompletableFuture 以成功或错误完成时继续。

items.source: returnValue - the value returned from the handler method
items.translation: returnValue - 从处理程序方法返回的值

items.source: returnType - the type of the return value
the resulting CompletableFuture, or null in which case no further handling will be performed
items.translation: 生成的 `CompletableFuture`，或为 `null`（此时将不再执行进一步的处理）。

items.source: Adapt the asynchronous return value to a CompletableFuture.
items.translation: 将异步返回值适配为 CompletableFuture。

items.source:
Whether the return value represents an asynchronous, Future-like type
with success and error callbacks.
items.translation: 返回值是否表示具有成功和错误回调的异步、Future 类型。

items.source: true if the return value type represents an async value
items.translation: true 如果返回值类型表示异步值。
